title: Lower highs after the snippet high
description: The snippet starts at 58,759 and falls to 57,384 before rallying to its 58,813 high (11 Jul 12:00). At level 1 that fall is just the first low; its own lower highs appear a level down. From the high, each bounce stops lower: 57,846, 57,558, 57,341 and 57,328, including a one-candle swing where the low and the next high are both 57,341. The first pullback low, 57,412, is a higher low because it is above 57,384, even though the highs are already falling.
